title: Render
description: The RESULT of executing one RenderManifest (PRD REQ-080/085/087, §5 object table) — what the manifest planned, this records was actually produced. The split matters: the manifest carries loudness/true-peak TARGETS, this carries the MEASURED values from the encoded file, and conflating them is how an unmeasured render comes to look compliant. `releaseState` (REQ-105) travels on the render so a `draft` can never be mistaken for an approved final. `determinismTier` is a `const 1` because tech-spec §12 permits exactly one determinism claim at Phase 0 (byte-identical, pinned local environment, D-33); tiers 2-3 belong to the Remotion path, which does not exist.

changelog.reason: Initial v1 (Phase 4, tech-spec §15 step 6). `loudness` is a TAGGED UNION rather than a nullable number pair: an audio-less source and a source whose loudness measurement failed are different facts, and a bare null makes them indistinguishable from `-inf LUFS`. REQ-085 requires the value to be reported, and 'reported' has to include reporting that it could not be measured, with the reason.

v2 (Stage 0B-3, D-62): job-relative path patterns on outputPath and captions.{ass,srt,vtt}Path — the fix Phase 5 residual 1 parked for a deliberate version bump. Previously these fields were described as job-relative but constrained only by minLength: 1, so schema validation accepted a traversing or absolute path and safety rested entirely on the code guard. The pattern is a conservative segment whitelist verified to behave identically under Ajv (ECMA) and Python re; what it cannot express (device names, containment) stays with the code guard, which is retained (D-62c).

renderManifestId.description: The manifest this render executed. Every reproduction detail lives there; this object never restates a knob the manifest already pins.

tier.description: D-34. Exit criterion 2 ('zero invalid source ranges in final renders') binds to `final`; `package` (Phase 5) bundles `final` only.

releaseState.description: REQ-105. Set to `editorially_approved` only by the Phase 5 approval flow, never by the renderer.

outputPath.description: Job-relative path to the encoded file, e.g. `renders/draft/<manifestId>/output.mp4`. Job-relative rather than absolute so an artefact stays valid when the job directory moves. The v2 pattern rejects absolute, drive-letter, UNC and backslash paths, dot/dot-dot segments and empty segments in BOTH validators; it deliberately does NOT cover Windows reserved device names or post-symlink containment — those remain the job of the code guard (assertJobRelativePath/resolveArtefactPath in @cutdown/contracts) at every join site, enforced by the artefact-path-discipline lint.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the encoded FILE BYTES (not the object). This is the value the tier-1 double-render determinism proof compares.

duration.description: Measured duration of the produced file, read back from the encoded output rather than summed from the EDL — a sum is the plan, not the result.

dimensions.title: RenderDimensions
dimensions.description: Measured output geometry, read back from the file. QA compares it against the manifest and the platform minResolution.

loudness.title: LoudnessReport
loudness.description: MEASURED integrated loudness and true peak (REQ-085), or an explicit statement that they could not be measured and why. A tagged union so 'this render has no audio' can never be read as 'this render measured 0 LUFS'.

integratedLufs.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness of the produced file.

truePeakDbtp.description: True peak in dBTP. The QA ruleset's `maxTruePeakDbtp` (default -1) is checked against THIS value.

reason.description: Why no measurement exists — e.g. `source has no audio stream`. Required: an unexplained absence is the failure mode this union exists to prevent.

captions.title: RenderedCaptions
captions.description: The emitted caption triplet (REQ-083/104), job-relative. A caption FILE is always emitted alongside the burn-in — REQ-104's standing requirement — so these three are required, not optional. In v2 each path carries the same job-relative pattern as outputPath (see its description for what the pattern does and does not cover).

cueCount.description: Number of caption cues emitted. Zero is legal (a clip with no speech and no text captions) and is recorded rather than inferred from an empty file.

renderer.title: RendererIdentity
renderer.description: Restated from the manifest ON PURPOSE (PRD §10.6): a delivered render travels with its provenance even when separated from its manifest. The resolver asserts the two agree.

determinismTier.description: tech-spec §12: Phase 0 claims tier 1 only — byte-identical on the pinned local environment (D-33). A `const` so a later renderer cannot quietly assert a stronger claim than the spec allows.

visibleVersionIdentifier.description: D-34: a `draft` render carries a burned-in version identifier so a review copy can never be mistaken for a deliverable; a `final` carries null. The renderer asserts the tier/identifier agreement (JSON Schema cannot express a cross-property rule; tech-spec §3 forbids if/then/else).
